text.en:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Perlembagaan Persekutuan
(Kajian Semula Pemberian Khas di bawah Perkara 112D) (Negeri Sarawak) 2023.

Pemberian khas

2. Bagi tempoh lima tahun berkuat kuasa mulai 1 Januari 202 3,
Kerajaan Persekutuan hendaklah membuat kepada Negeri Sarawak, berkenaan dengan
tahun kewangan 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026 dan 2027, pemberian masing-masing berjumlah
RM300 juta, RM306 juta, RM312 juta, RM318 juta dan RM325 juta.

Pembatalan

3. Perentah (Ulangkaji Pertama)  Pemberian Khas Sa rawak, 1969
[P.U. (A) 403/1969] dibatalkan.

Dibuat 22 November 2023
[MOF.NBO(R)600-8/4/1 JLD.3(5); PN(PU2)171/XXV]

 Dengan Titah Perintah

ANWAR BIN IBRAHIM
Menteri Kewangan

FEDERAL CONSTITUTION

FEDERAL CONSTITUTION (REVIEW OF SPECIAL GRANT UNDER ARTICLE 112D)
(STATE OF SARAWAK) ORDER 2023

WHEREAS by virtue of Clause (1) of Article 112 D of the Federal Constitution,
the special grant made to the State of Sarawak as specified in paragraph (a) Clause (1)
of Article 112 C of the Federal Constitution shall be reviewed by
the Governments of the Federation and the State of Sarawak;

AND WHEREAS the review was held by the Governments of the Federation
and the State of Sarawak on 8 April 2023 and 12 June 2023;

AND WHEREAS the said review has resulted in the Governments
of the Federation and the State of S arawak agreeing that for the period of five years
with effect  from 202 3 to 202 7, the Government of the Federation shall make to
the Government of the State of Sa rawak, in respect of each financial year, another grant
instead of the grant made under the Sa rawak Special Grants (First Review) Order, 1969
[P.U. (A) 403/1969];

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers confer red by Clause (1) of
Article 112 D of the Federal Constitution, the Yang di -Pertuan Agong makes
the following order:
